draft_hash_rule: Parse JSON, remove only the top-level draft_sha256 field, serialize with sorted keys and compact separators as UTF-8, then SHA-256.

family_distinction.driver: Only the magnitude of strictly lagged fixed-50/50 BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT portfolio volatility changes aggregate risky exposure; BTC and ETH target risky weights are always equal.
family_distinction.not_prior_bounded_inverse_volatility: No per-asset volatility, covariance risk contribution, or inverse-volatility asset tilt enters relative allocation; the risky sleeve is permanently 50/50.
family_distinction.not_trend: No return sign, breakout, moving average, or directional forecast is used. Estimated volatility magnitude alone scales long exposure toward cash, never above one.
family_distinction.not_mean_reversion_relative_value_or_cal: No dip/recovery, reversal, winner rank, rotation, one-asset state, weekday expected return, or hour expected return is used.
family_distinction.no_transformation: The primary cannot be replaced by a trial, benchmark, fitted model, asset tilt, return filter, leverage rule, or post-data target-volatility choice.

economic_hypothesis: A fixed equal-weight BTC/ETH sleeve scaled down into non-interest-bearing cash when causally lagged portfolio volatility exceeds a fixed 40% annual target may reduce volatility clustering and drawdown enough to improve net risk-adjusted performance versus fully invested equal-weight baselines after conservative spot costs, without return direction, asset selection, or leverage.

data_identity_contract.allowlist_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the following exact ordered development_allowlist array serialized with sorted keys, compact separators, and UTF-8.
data_identity_contract.pre_open_verification: Before any development path resolution, stat, footer, schema, metadata, dataset construction, or value read, verify the reused-contract canonical hash, source commit, allowlist count, and allowlist hash. For each selected path verify exact relative path, byte count, and SHA-256, then rehash the exact opened bytes before parsing. Any mismatch is terminal DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
data_identity_contract.session_input_manifest: For each constructed session persist an ordered list of relative path, file SHA-256, row identifier, event_timestamp, available_timestamp, and canonical row hash. Its canonical JSON hash uses sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, and SHA-256.
data_identity_contract.holdout_guard: Every 2026 path is rejected before resolution, stat, footer, schema, metadata, dataset construction, or value access unless the fixed-path irreversible holdout authorization and latch validate.

joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.row_clock: A UTC session D comprises exactly the 1,440 expected row event timestamps D+00:01:00 through D+1 day+00:00:00, each representing the corresponding whole-minute open timestamp one minute earlier. Build this expected grid from half-open evaluation boundaries before matching observations.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.valid_row: Exactly one finite valid-OHLC record per expected event timestamp and asset, with event and causal availability timestamps ordered and an unambiguous open timestamp. Duplicates, nonmonotonic input order, invalid OHLC, missing, asynchronous, partial, or absent rows make the joint session incomplete.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.causal_detection: An invalid or duplicate row is detected at its causal available_timestamp. A missing expected row e is detected at the maximum of e and the available_timestamp of the earliest subsequently available row from either asset; a missing terminal row with no later record before boundary is detected at the boundary. A wholly absent session is therefore detected when the first later row becomes available or at the evaluation boundary. Persist the trigger and detection time.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.quarantine_trigger: Any incomplete joint session cancels every pending target, clears sleeve-return and regime histories, and enters quarantine. Cash paths remain cash. Exposed paths retain priced exposure until safety liquidation.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.exposed_safety_liquidation: Liquidate an exposed path at the earliest later finite valid synchronized BTC/ETH minute-open vector whose event and availability timestamps are strictly after the causal trigger. This scan is only for mandatory safety liquidation, never an ordinary target fill. Charge cost and persist the vector. If none exists before T_E, terminate DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.drawdown_limitation: The event-level path includes initial wealth and every supplied finite synchronized minute mark, fill, cost, safety liquidation, and terminal liquidation. No mark is fabricated inside an unpriceable gap; exposure remains economically continuous and the first later valid mark captures the entire move. This limitation is recorded. A required endpoint or terminal vector that is unpriceable while exposed is DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.recovery: After a trigger, require 90 new contiguous complete joint sessions and the trial's full contiguous lookback. Old observations never bridge the gap.
joint_session_gap_and_quarantine.missing_ordinary_fill: If exact B_s is missing, invalid, asynchronous, partial, or nonfinite, never scan for another ordinary fill. Cancel the target and trigger quarantine; apply safety liquidation only if the path was already exposed.
failure_precedence: Input identity, trace mismatch, unpriceable required endpoint or terminal, and unrecoverable exposed-liquidation defects terminate DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
A scheduled finite-estimator, scalar, or target degeneracy terminates NUMERICAL_DEGENERACY_FAILURE; it never skips, carries a target, or becomes discretionary cash.
Only a complete evaluation with valid evidence whose economic or robustness gate fails is HISTORICAL_NO_GO.
Only a complete evaluation with every gate true is DEVELOPMENT_GO.

estimator_and_primary.daily_endpoint: The exact synchronized BTC/ETH minute-open vector at 23:59:00 UTC, corresponding to event timestamp next-day 00:00:00; no substitute.
estimator_and_primary.paired_asset_returns: Simple returns between endpoints exactly one calendar day apart. Missing days are not bridged. A genuine zero return exists only from two valid priceable endpoints.
estimator_and_primary.sleeve_return: r_sleeve,d=0.5*r_BTC,d+0.5*r_ETH,d. This hypothetical daily-rebalanced 50/50 series is used only by the volatility estimator; actual holdings rebalance only on scheduled fills and otherwise drift.
estimator_and_primary.volatility: Sample standard deviation ddof=1 of exactly 60 contiguous finite sleeve returns, multiplied by sqrt(365). It must be finite and strictly positive.
estimator_and_primary.scalar: g_raw=0.40/sigma_hat; g=min(1,max(0,g_raw)). Compute once in float64. Nonfinite sigma, g_raw, or g, sigma<=0, or g outside [0,1] after tolerance is terminal NUMERICAL_DEGENERACY_FAILURE.
estimator_and_primary.weights: BTC=0.5*g, ETH=0.5*g, cash=1-g. BTC and ETH are produced from the same scalar and must be bitwise equal; finite weights sum to one within 1e-12. No leverage, shorting, asset tilt, return filter, volatility floor, or cash yield.
estimator_and_primary.schedule: Materialize one target after every eligible completed UTC Sunday session. Weekday has no expected-return meaning.
estimator_and_primary.between_fills: Hold units and cash; risky weights drift with prices.

trials.inheritance: A trial changes only its declared target, lookback, or schedule; every other data, clock, trace, fill, cost, quarantine, terminal, panel, statistic, gate, and failure rule is identical.

target_fill_and_accounting_trace.information_time: For decision session s, I_s is the maximum event_timestamp and available_timestamp over both assets and every record in the trial estimator; derive only from the persisted ordered input manifest.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.base_fill_clock: B_s is the first whole-minute open timestamp strictly greater than I_s. The only base fill is the atomic BTC/ETH vector whose event timestamp is B_s+one minute. Later availability may validate it but cannot choose another B_s.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.canonical_hash_rule: Every record below is JSON with exactly the declared keys, sorted-key compact UTF-8 serialization, and SHA-256. No NaN, infinity, omitted nullable key, platform-dependent float text, or additional key is allowed.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.target_before_fill: Persist and validate the immutable target hash before any fill. Every distinct trial, benchmark, boundary, decision, or weight vector has a distinct target record; benchmark weights cannot reuse a primary target hash.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.delay: Run independently from cash. The exact same target hash remains pending through one additional completed joint session and executes only at its exact next eligible vector. No later target supersedes it; quarantine or terminal override cancels it.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.event_order: Detect causal integrity, mark existing holdings at the valid vector, perform safety-liquidation precedence, execute one eligible pending target, then persist event wealth and state.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.contributions: For each priced interval attribute gross quote-currency PnL by starting units. Allocate each exact currency cost to BTC and ETH proportional to their absolute risky-weight changes. BTC+ETH+zero cash contribution reconciles to terminal wealth minus initial wealth within 1e-10 relative tolerance.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.independence: Base, doubled-cost, delay, every fold, every trial, and every benchmark begin from independent wealth one in cash and share no mutable portfolio state.
target_fill_and_accounting_trace.terminal: For every half-open path ending E, T_E=E-one minute is predeclared. Submit unconditional cash before the exact synchronized vector at T_E, cancel pending targets, liquidate with cost, and require exact cash. Missing or invalid T_E is DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE; no earlier fallback.

panels_and_benchmarks.trial_common_endpoint_panel: The exact sorted intersection of finite valid 23:59 endpoint timestamps across all seven independently simulated trials. A return is included only when both endpoints are in the intersection and exactly one calendar day apart. Missing spans are absent, never bridged or zero-filled. A zero is included only when both endpoints are valid and wealth is genuinely unchanged, including genuine cash.
panels_and_benchmarks.cash_unavailable_span: If every trial is cash but an endpoint vector is unavailable, that endpoint and adjacent returns are absent, not zero. If any trial is exposed at an unavailable required endpoint, terminate DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
panels_and_benchmarks.uses: Primary Sharpe, stationary bootstrap, DSR, and the seven-column PBO matrix use only the trial common panel. Minimum development common endpoints are 321, producing at least 320 returns.
panels_and_benchmarks.cash: Zero return and zero cost on valid comparison timestamps.
panels_and_benchmarks.equal_weight_weekly_fully_invested: Use BTC=0.5, ETH=0.5, cash=0 at exact primary eligibility/decision clocks, with its own target/fill hashes and identical boundary, data, cost, quarantine, execution availability, endpoint, and terminal rules.
panels_and_benchmarks.equal_weight_buy_and_hold: Enter 0.5/0.5 at the primary first eligible fill, drift until safety or terminal liquidation, and re-enter only at the first later primary-eligible recovery fill; use its own hashes and identical data, cost, quarantine, endpoint, and terminal rules.
panels_and_benchmarks.asset_buy_and_hold: BTC and ETH standalone diagnostic paths use the same primary first-entry, recovery/re-entry, endpoint, cost, and terminal rules.
panels_and_benchmarks.baseline_comparison_panel: The exact further intersection of the seven-trial common endpoints and both equal-weight benchmark endpoint sets, with only exactly consecutive calendar-day pairs. Recompute primary and both benchmark net return, annualized Sharpe, and event-level maximum drawdown on identical comparison timestamps and corresponding event slices.
baseline_superiority_all_strict: primary aggregate net return > equal_weight_weekly_fully_invested aggregate net return
primary annualized Sharpe > equal_weight_weekly_fully_invested annualized Sharpe
primary annualized Sharpe > equal_weight_buy_and_hold annualized Sharpe
primary event-level maximum drawdown < equal_weight_weekly_fully_invested event-level maximum drawdown
primary event-level maximum drawdown < equal_weight_buy_and_hold event-level maximum drawdown
panels_and_benchmarks.baseline_ties: Every tie or nonfinite comparison fails. No metric substitution or benchmark selection is permitted. The separate positive-net gate establishes superiority to cash; cash drawdown is not compared.

walk_forward.strict_prefix_slicing: Before any estimator, expected-grid, validity, schedule, quarantine, or terminal operation, slice each fold to rows strictly before its end. Mutations at or after the boundary cannot affect it.
walk_forward.fold_initialization: At each fold start initialize wealth one in exact cash with no position, units, PnL, pending target, prior decision, or carried quarantine state. Pre-start rows within the fold's allowed historical prefix may affect only causal estimator and recovery warmup; they cannot create a pre-start target, fill, position, pending state, or PnL.

statistics.daily_sharpe: For any fixed panel, nonannualized Sharpe is sample mean divided by sample standard deviation ddof=1. Annualized Sharpe is daily Sharpe*sqrt(365). Unless a rule below specifies infinity for ranking, nonfinite or zero volatility fails the relevant gate.

stationary_bootstrap.restart: For b, start each length-T replicate at a uniform index. At each next draw restart at a new uniform index with probability 1/b; otherwise advance one index modulo T.
stationary_bootstrap.percentiles: NumPy linear percentiles 0.025 and 0.975 of replicate mean daily return.
stationary_bootstrap.degenerate: Any nonfinite input/output, T<2, empty replicate, invalid restart, seed mismatch, or nonpositive required denominator fails.

DSR.sigma_SR: Sample standard deviation ddof=1 of exactly 35 hash-bound observed nonannualized daily Sharpes; the seven calendar slots get no value.
DSR.observed: Current primary nonannualized Sharpe on the exact seven-trial common panel.
DSR.autocorrelation: Sample autocorrelation of demeaned primary common-panel returns for k=1..28; nonfinite or zero denominator fails.
DSR.moments: Bias-false sample skew and nonexcess kurtosis.
DSR.degenerate: Missing/hash-incompatible prior, missing trial, wrong count/order, zero sigma_SR, invalid rho, T_eff<30, nonpositive denominator, or any nonfinite quantity yields probability zero.

PBO.scope: Seven current trial columns on the exact trial common daily return matrix.
PBO.blocks: numpy.array_split into eight nonempty chronological blocks.
PBO.sharpe_for_ranking: Mean/std ddof=1; zero volatility maps to negative infinity unless mean>0, then positive infinity.
PBO.training_selection: Maximum training Sharpe, exact ties resolved by declared trial order.
PBO.test_rank: Rank selected-trial test Sharpe worst=1 through best=7 with average ties; relative_rank=rank/8.
PBO.degenerate: Missing columns/timestamps, empty block, nonfinite value, unresolved infinity/tie, invalid rank/logit, or split-count mismatch yields PBO=1.

regimes.assignment: At each included daily interval start, use only the preceding completed synchronized BTC session. Assign interval price PnL, costs, and safety-liquidation PnL to that interval-start label.
regimes.trend: Up iff close_s/close_(s-120)-1>0; equality or less is down.
regimes.volatility: Compute current BTC 60-simple-return ddof=1 volatility. High iff strictly above the expanding median of at least 120 prior eligible volatility estimates excluding current; equality or less is low.
regimes.gap: Incomplete joint session clears close, volatility-estimate, and median histories.
regimes.eligibility: At least 45 included daily intervals and five completed scheduled fills.
regimes.gate: At least three regimes eligible; each eligible regime net return >0 and none below -5%.
regimes.degenerate: Insufficient history makes interval unlabeled and excluded; nonfinite label inputs fail data integrity.

statistics.event_drawdown: max_t(1-W_t/max_{u<=t}W_u) on the valid synchronized event path defined above.
statistics.exceptional_profit: Denominator is finite sum of strictly positive daily interval net currency PnL. Nonpositive/nonfinite denominator fails. Largest fraction <=0.50 and top-five fraction <=0.75.
statistics.asset_contribution_and_concentration: Both reconciled BTC and ETH net contributions >0. Total positive net contribution must be >0; each asset's positive contribution divided by total positive contribution <=0.80. Any nonfinite value or denominator fails.
statistics.rebalance_count: Count one completed scheduled target execution including initial entry. Terminal/safety liquidations, pending targets, retries, marks, duplicate processing, and cancelled targets do not count.

development_gates_all_required.any_failure: HISTORICAL_NO_GO only after a complete valid evaluation; integrity and numerical terminal classifications have precedence.

holdout_one_shot.pre_access_gate: Every development gate and trace passes and a separate live Sol/xhigh audit returns HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED.
holdout_one_shot.authorization: Commit clean source binding frozen contract, reused data, exact 12 holdout path/byte/SHA-256 entries, evaluator, tests, seeds, registries, development result, validation, and pre-access audit.
holdout_one_shot.create: Reject any pre-existing path. Exclusive-create once with schema, experiment, invocation id, authorization hashes, accessed=false; fsync file and containing directory.
holdout_one_shot.arm: Immediately before the first 2026 path resolution or stat, atomically replace the same path with identical authorization plus accessed=true and first_access_at_utc; fsync file and containing directory.
holdout_one_shot.guard: Reject every 2026 path before resolution, stat, footer, schema, metadata, dataset construction, or value access unless authorization and armed latch validate.
holdout_one_shot.one_invocation: Exactly one deterministic invocation and zero post-arm repair attempts. Any pre-existing, malformed, mismatched, or accessed latch, or any error/interruption after arming, is terminal; no deletion, reset, repair, rerun, reopen, or partial selection.
holdout_one_shot.all_other_gates: Every other inherited and supplemental development gate is identical, including net, Sharpe, drawdown, costs, delay, all bootstrap bounds, DSR, PBO, three-of-four neighbors, all-six baseline rule, contributions, concentration, regimes, exceptional profit, leakage, survivorship, data integrity, terminal cash, input/trace reconciliation, and zero capital.

prospective.candidate_freeze: Only after every holdout gate and a separate live Sol/xhigh terminal audit pass; freeze all data, source, code, contract, trace, seed, registry, and timestamp hashes with capital zero.
prospective.post_freeze_only: Every estimator row, event, availability, decision, target, and fill timestamp is strictly after candidate freeze; rebuild lookback from post-freeze observations.
prospective.decision_key: experiment_id plus unique eligible Sunday signal-session end.
prospective.count: Count once after a complete target/source trace is materialized. A new Sunday counts even if weights equal the prior target. Reruns, retries, duplicate processing, or recomputation of the same key never count; pending fills, safety liquidations, and terminal cash do not count.
prospective.dependence: Operational uniqueness is not IID; overlapping lookbacks make decisions strongly dependent.
